Compare GnRHcell results across datasets

Source: R/collection.R
compare_gnrh_datasets.Rd

Combines dataset-level GnRHcell outputs to compare runtime, detected GnRH cells, marker overlap, and optionally conserved marker programs.

Usage

compare_gnrh_datasets(
  datasets,
  output_dir,
  run_programs = TRUE,
  run_gallery = FALSE,
  objects = NULL
)

Arguments

datasets

A dataset configuration data frame containing at least id and label.

output_dir

Character scalar giving the GnRHcell output directory.

run_programs

Logical. Whether to compute conserved marker programs. Default is TRUE.

run_gallery

Logical. Whether to build cross-dataset detection and developmental-stage gallery assets. Default is FALSE.

objects

Optional named list of processed Seurat objects. When NULL, gallery generation looks for saved objects in output_dir/objects.

Value

A named list containing:

run_info_files

Run-information files included in the comparison.

marker_files

Marker files included in the comparison.

runtime_plot

Runtime comparison plot, if available.

detected_plot

Detected GnRH cell comparison plot, if available.

overlap

Marker overlap results, if at least two marker files are available.

programs

Conserved marker program results, if requested and available.

gallery

Detection summary, UMAP gallery, and stage-composition gallery, if requested and processed objects are available.

Details

The function expects outputs previously generated by run_gnrh_collection() or run_gnrh_dataset().

See also

run_gnrh_collection(), gnrh_marker_programs()
